name: CVeek Jobs
author: cveek

sections.description:
The CVeek Jobs Plugin allows you to automatically display your company’s job openings from CVeek directly on your WordPress website — without manual updates or duplicated work.

Once connected, every job you publish on CVeek appears instantly on your site, keeping your careers page always up to date.

Key Features

Save HR Time and Resources
No more copy-pasting jobs into your site — publish once on CVeek and manage everything from one dashboard.

Automatic Job Sync
Jobs published or updated on CVeek automatically sync to your WordPress careers page.

Real-Time Job Visibility
Visitors to your website can instantly view open positions, helping candidates discover open positions directly from your website.

Seamless Application Integration
When applicants click on a job, they are redirected to the official CVeek application page for that job, ensuring smooth, centralized recruitment tracking.

Boost Your SEO and Online Visibility
Publishing job listings on your website can help search engines discover and index your open positions more effectively.

Compatible with All Modern WordPress Versions
Install in minutes directly from your WordPress admin dashboard — with no coding required.

Transform your website into a fully-integrated, automated career portal with CVeek.

External Services

This plugin connects to the CVeek platform API to synchronize and display company job listings on your WordPress website.

It sends the following data to the CVeek API:
– Company profile slug
– Website domain URL
– Plugin identifier/name

This data is sent only when:
– The administrator connects the plugin to a CVeek company account
– The plugin requests synchronized job listings from CVeek

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress, the plugin will redirect you to the plugin settings page.
  3. Contact CVeek website and send them your website URL.
  4. When you get a confirmation from CVeek website click on Setup Plugin button on settings page.
  5. Enter your Company Profile Slug and save changes.

Help Tip To get Company Profile Slug:
1. Log in to your CVeek account.
2. Go to your company account settings.
3. Copy the last part of your Profile URL.
4. Paste it into the Company Profile Slug field.

Example:
If your profile URL is:
https://cveek.com/i/c/my-company-profile-slug

Enter:
my-company-profile-slug
sections.faq:
Do I need technical skills to use this plugin?

No. Installation and setup take only a few minutes and require no coding.

Do jobs update automatically?

Yes. Job listings sync automatically whenever you add or update jobs on CVeek.

Where do applicants submit their applications?

Applicants apply directly through CVeek.

Why is prior approval from CVeek website required before using the CVeek Jobs Plugin?

The CVeek Jobs Plugin connects directly to the CVeek API to display your company’s job listings.
For security reasons, your website domain must be authorized first.
Please contact the CVeek team and provide your website URL. Once approved, you can complete the plugin setup and start displaying jobs automatically.
